_note: Animazioni Kimodo del gioco. npm run kimodo -- batch genera quelle che mancano (assets-src/kimodo/<name>). seconds 2-5; inPlace (predefinito true) toglie l'avanzare; loop: { minSeconds } la rende ciclica. Cambiare inPlace/loop non richiede di rigenerare: basta npm run kimodo -- retarget. rootMotion: true (partenze, fermate, svolte) toglie anche la direzione del corpo e scrive in kimodoClips.json come la clip avanza e gira, per il gioco. Cambiare prompt/seed/seconds si': cancella la cartella e rilancia batch.

animations.name: getup_back
animations.prompt: A person lying flat on their back on the ground gets up to a standing position.

animations.name: getup_front
animations.prompt: A person lying face down on the ground pushes up with both arms and gets up to a standing position.

animations.name: getup_hurt
animations.prompt: A person lying on their back slowly and painfully gets up, holding their stomach with one hand.

animations.name: stumble_back
animations.prompt: A person is shoved hard in the chest, stumbles backward a few steps and regains balance.

animations.name: stumble_forward
animations.prompt: A person is pushed from behind, stumbles forward a few steps and catches their balance.

animations.name: stumble_left
animations.prompt: A person is shoved from the right side, stumbles sideways to the left and recovers their balance.

animations.name: stumble_right
animations.prompt: A person is shoved from the left side, stumbles sideways to the right and recovers their balance.

animations.name: hit_back
animations.prompt: A person is hit hard in the back and flinches forward, arching the back in pain.

animations.name: hit_left
animations.prompt: A person is hit on the left side of the body and recoils to the right.

animations.name: hit_right
animations.prompt: A person is hit on the right side of the body and recoils to the left.

animations.name: hit_stomach
animations.prompt: A person is punched in the stomach, doubles over in pain and then straightens up.

animations.name: look_around
animations.prompt: A person stands still and looks around curiously, turning the head left and right.

animations.name: wait_impatient
animations.prompt: A person stands waiting impatiently, shifting weight from foot to foot and checking the watch on the left wrist.

animations.name: stretch
animations.prompt: A person stands and stretches both arms high above the head, then relaxes.

animations.name: phone_talk
animations.prompt: A person stands talking on a phone held to the right ear, gesturing with the left hand.

animations.name: point_shout
animations.prompt: A person points ahead with the right arm and shouts angrily.

animations.name: cower

animations.name: panic_run
animations.prompt: A person runs forward in panic, waving the arms and looking back over the shoulder.

animations.name: injured_walk
animations.prompt: A person walks forward slowly, limping on the left leg and holding their side in pain.

animations.name: out_of_breath

animations.name: victory
animations.prompt: A person celebrates a victory, jumping and raising both fists in the air.

animations.name: victory_dance

animations.name: walk_start

animations.name: run_start

animations.name: walk_stop

animations.name: run_stop

animations.name: turn_left_90

animations.name: turn_right_90
animations.prompt: A person standing still turns ninety degrees to the right in place with small steps, then stands still.

animations.name: turn_180

animations.name: walk_upstairs

animations.name: walk_downstairs
